title: Latent Prediction Yields Cross-Subject Alignable Representations in Sensory-Evoked fMRI
abstract: arXiv:2610.40280v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decoding sensory-evoked functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data is a central analytical tool in cognitive neuroscience. Here we ask whether self-supervised learning (SSL), which has been scarcely explored in this domain, can yield representations that support strong downstream performance. To do so, we adapt a joint embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) to train participant-specific encoders on brain data alone. The encoders never see the stimulus images or any representation derived from them. Applied to the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD), we evaluate our learned brain embeddings on the downstream tasks of brain captioning and image reconstruction, as well as cross-participant generalization. translated_title: 潜空间预测在感觉诱发fMRI中产生可跨被试对齐的表征
translated_abstract: 解码感觉诱发的功能磁共振成像（fMRI）数据是认知神经科学中的一项核心分析工具。在此，我们探讨自我监督学习（SSL）——这一在该领域尚未被充分探索的方法——能否产生支持强大下游性能的表征。为此，我们改编了一种联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），仅使用大脑数据来训练针对每位被试的编码器。这些编码器从未见过刺激图像，也从未见过任何由刺激图像派生的表征。我们将该方法应用于自然场景数据集（NSD），在脑字幕生成和图像重建这两个下游任务以及跨被试泛化方面评估我们学习到的大脑嵌入。我们的自监督方法取得了与参数丰富的监督式流程（这些流程在端到端训练中可访问图像和语言数据）相竞争的性能。我们进一步发现，针对不同被试独立训练的编码器……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出将JEPA自监督架构改编用于仅凭大脑数据训练个体化fMRI编码器，在不接触任何刺激图像的情况下，在脑字幕生成和图像重建任务上取得了与参数丰富的监督式方法相竞争的性能，并产生了可跨被试对齐的大脑表征。
en_tdlr: This paper adapts a JEPA self-supervised architecture to train participant-specific fMRI encoders using brain data alone—never seeing stimulus images—achieving competitive performance on brain captioning and image reconstruction while yielding cross-subject alignable representations.
